address: 1F, H Code, 45 Pottinger Street, Central, Hong Kong, Hong Kong SAR China
bio: In 2022, owner-chef Alvin Leung moved his highly acclaimed restaurant to this new spot. Just like the art that exudes local flavours, his playful creations are a nod to the Hong Kong food culture. The only tasting menu served at dinner is full of surprises, changing themes from time to time. Pleasant surprises, bespoke serving vessels and theatrical presentation make for a fun-filled, immersive experience....
